column18: There are a variety of positions that must be filled to ensure that camp runs smoothly. Please select your top 3 preferred tasks, with the understanding that assignments will be made based upon what positions need to be filled and not necessarily on these preferences. As hair clinic, crafts, and serving lines are not considered full-time duties, individuals volunteering for those tasks will be assigned additional jobs as well. All that you do, do it as unto the Lord.
